summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video: Pleats Mini-Class ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will learn how to create a soft cymbal movement in Marvelous Designer. This guide will cover the use of the extension tool and various techniques for creating pleats. ## Creating a Soft Cymbal Movement To begin, use the extension tool to select the fold line in the middle and spread it to both sides. As you move the mouse, you will notice a chasing area. ### Understanding the Chasing Area The characteristic of the chasing area is that the fabric gradually changes from one direction rather than along the entire width. This means that the total length of the sewing line remains unchanged. After simulation, you will observe that a wider fold is appearing, which corresponds to the chasing area we just added. As a result, the length of the sewing line stays the same, ensuring that there will be no folds along the sewing line. ## Applications of the Technique This technique can be utilized for various designs, such as skirts and flower borders. Additionally, some light shows are created this way to achieve effects like fabric hammering and stacking. ## Adding Additional Folds If you wish to add another fold, continue using the extension tool at the corresponding position. Select one side of the board and then rotate it. ### Managing Straight Line Points The extension board is connected by straight line points, resulting in sudden twists whenever you pass a straight line point. Such twists can create issues with feet sticking out. To address this, select the heavy turning points and convert them to free curve points. After converting to a curve, the entire line section will be smoother, eliminating any protruding structures and increasing the overall length. ## Increasing the Number of Pleats If you need to increase the number of pleats in the pleating section, simply continue to extend the board. You will notice that the more pleating there is, the better the overall effect. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching this video. I hope you found it helpful and that it inspires you to continue your work in Marvelous Designer. Remember, it's just you and your creativity, and I trust you to make beautiful designs. I appreciate your attention and enthusiasm! ```
